lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit, following the longitudinal axis of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a grid, with high-luminance blobs acting as anchor nodes at these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition (high luminance on the dorsal side, shadow on the ventral side) extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notches and a non-linear trailing edge are visible on the distal portion of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated dark pixel cluster representing a commensal organism is visible trailing the ventral-posterior region of the shark.
